Graduate Programs
Pursue Your Future. At Your Pace.
Push the boundaries of tomorrow with a dynamic graduate degree in Computer and Electrical Engineering from Old Dominion University. ODU’s highly personalized graduate programs are built for working professionals, offering both the flexibility to attend classes part time and an affordable path to a high-earning career. Immerse yourself in rigorous, hands-on graduate studies that put you at the forefront of university research and industry innovation. Program options range from Masters and Doctoral degrees to Graduate Certificates, with specializations in Computer Networking, Technology Creation, Hardware and Software Development, Cybersecurity, Machine Learning, Modeling & Simulation and Electrical Engineering. Explore it all here, and apply today.
Apply Now
Request Information
Why Pursue a Graduate Degree at ODU?
Career Advancement: Position yourself for boundless career opportunities in more specialized, technical and leadership positions
High-Level Experience: Work on cutting-edge technologies with opportunities to assist in student and faculty-led research projects
Cutting-Edge Research: Enjoy instant access to university research in a vibrant academic culture filled with workshops, mentorship and discovery
Global Career Opportunities: Take advantage of the university's vast industry connections to work for top-tier companies and start-ups worldwide.

Linked Bachelor's / Master's Programs
These programs are designed to allow qualified students to secure a space in a Master’s program available in the Frank Batten College of Engineering and Technology while they are still pursuing their undergraduate degrees. Learn more about the linked programs.
Tuition & Financial Aid
Teaching Assistantship
The Teaching Assistantship is provided by the department for students with excellent qualifications. Students interested in TA should complete a TA application form together with the program application.
Research Assistantship
The Research Assistantship is provided by individual professors. Interested students will be automatically considered for RAs by selecting "Research Assistantship" for financial aid in their application.
